WHAT WE DO

Seven sectors, one standard of service.

From ICT to agro crop, real estate to travel — explore how Asknetic serves Tanzania's growing business landscape.

01 — ICT & DIGITAL SOLUTIONS

Systems, networks & cybersecurity

The Group specialises in the provision of Information and Communication Technology and Digital Solutions, including systems integration, network infrastructure, software solutions, IT support services, cybersecurity, and digital transformation services.

02 — REAL ESTATE

Market, lease and sell property

Asknetic signifies an energetic and contemporary future in property services — combining no-nonsense, down-to-earth advice with an advanced, digital-first approach to marketing, leasing and selling property.

We love talking about real estate and connecting with people from all walks of life. Anyone is invited to drop in, speak to our team, and see what we're all about.

03 — AGRO CROP

Organic crops, Halal-certified meat

Supporting our local farmers is a crucial value at Asknetic. We deal with organic cash crops including sesame seeds, cashew nuts, maize, mung beans and wheat.

We aim to become a leading exporter of bulk agricultural commodities worldwide, and one of the best Halal-certified meat sellers from Africa — with total quality control from beginning to end of production.

04 — BUILDING MAINTENANCE

Cleaning, repairs & upkeep, covered

Building maintenance includes cleaning common areas, removing trash regularly, and repairing broken items. Our scope covers:

  • Painting
  • Plumbing
  • Landscaping
  • Fumigation
  • Carpentry
  • Electrical & AC
05 — CAR HIRE

Mainland Tanzania & Zanzibar

At Asknetic, we're totally committed to bringing you the lowest car rental rates. Whether travelling for business or pleasure, you're guaranteed some of the best deals on rental wheels.

We've established ourselves as one of Tanzania's fast-growing car rental companies — delivering locally relevant, world-class service with a dynamic, fresh attitude.

06 — TRAVEL AGENCY & VISA ASSISTANCE

Flights booked, visas sorted

Visa Assistance — comprehensive, experienced visa aid and counselling, ensuring all paperwork meets the latest standards of the destination nation.

Flight Booking — for corporate, leisure, medical and sports travellers alike, finding inexpensive flights to anywhere in the world.

07 — GENERAL SUPPLIES

Import, export & commercial flows

We establish long, close relationships with clients and suppliers — creating commercial flows, importing and exporting products, and managing international projects with our partners.

  • Fire Equipment
  • Building Material
  • Office Equipment
  • ICT Equipment
